decision: Close the shared rank-256 QKV/O all-head factorization and all rank/allocation variants under this branch. The speed-compatible ranks retain insufficient operator energy and fail both attention and final gates by wide margins. Authorize one complete-cost review of a materially distinct fixed 1:8 structured source-weight support preserving every head slot. No density, grouping, scoring, data, seed, source, or gate sweep is authorized. If that fixed structured support fails, close direct per-layer source-attention compression and return to a cross-layer capability compiler representation.
claim_boundary: Negative shared low-rank source-attention evidence only; no component, installed host, physical runtime, autonomous, complete-model, Phase 3, or superiority claim.
